Class EndGameEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.UpdateEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.EndGameEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EndGameEvent extends UpdateEvent
Event representing the end of a game. Inherits from UpdateEvent. It contains the final state of the board, the final attributes of the players, the game's final ranking, and the overall global ranking.

  • Constructor Details

    • EndGameEvent

      public EndGameEvent(Board board, List<Player> finalRanking, int gameId, List<String> globalRank)
      Constructs an EndGameEvent triggered by the server model at the end of the game.
      Parameters:
      board - the final Board state of the game.
      finalRanking - a list of Player objects ordered by their final score.
      gameId - the unique ID of the game this event belongs to.
      globalRank - the updated global ranking across the server.

    • EndGameEvent

      public EndGameEvent(String description, ArrayList<String> finalRank, ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> board, Map<String, ArrayList<Integer>> playersAttributes, List<String> globalRank)
      Constructs an EndGameEvent from JSON data, used by Jackson upon receiving a message.
      Parameters:
      description - the description of the event.
      finalRank - the list of player nicknames ordered by their final placement.
      board - the state of the board represented by card IDs.
      playersAttributes - a map associating each player's nickname with a list of their attributes.
      globalRank - the overall global ranking leaderboard.
